bugs.what: Picking up 'a mountaineer's ice axe' silently replaced the equipped plain sword ('You will fight with it now') with no prompt or way to decline/compare stats first.

The 'call it a draw between them' companion-dispute option is framed as a fair mediation, but a failed will roll (which happened twice) causes BOTH companions to disapprove simultaneously, a harsher penalty than just picking a side outright.
bugs.where: companion dialogue after resting a hold (e.g. The Empty Seat, The Old Court)

confusions: The Act 2/3 status text names 'the first Reeve's confession' as a finale requirement from very early on, but gives no hint of where to find it until you're deep inside Marrowgate's crypts — for most of the game it's an untraceable checklist item.

Score is displayed as 'N/366' well before the midgame (e.g. 198/366 at turn ~215), which reads like an arbitrary point total, when 366 is actually the exact perfect-score cap for the whole run — this isn't stated anywhere.
suggestions: When an item auto-replaces the equipped weapon, show a one-line stat comparison (old vs new hit/dmg) instead of swapping silently.
Add a status hint once the 3rd hollow is rested, pointing toward roughly where the first Reeve's confession can be found (e.g. 'said to be owed somewhere under Marrowgate itself').
Note explicitly in status or the intro that the score denominator (e.g. /366) represents a fixed achievable maximum, not a rolling total.
